BEFORE YOU TAKE THE WHEEL

Good questions.
Clear next steps.

How do I check which cars are available?+

Choose a car category or use the search above, then send your preferences on WhatsApp. Our team can share current stock, photos, specifications and prices. Photos on this website illustrate car categories and are not live stock listings.

Can I book a test drive?+

Yes. Use “Book a test drive” to request a preferred date and car. The showroom will confirm the car, appointment time and any requirements directly. A request is not a confirmed booking.

Can I buy a car on finance?+

Ask the team about available finance options. Loan approval, interest rates, down payment and documents depend on the lender and your eligibility. The EMI calculator gives an estimate to help you plan.

Can I sell or exchange my current car?+

Car Choice handles used-car sale and purchase. Share your car’s model, year and kilometres to start the discussion. Any final valuation or exchange offer is subject to the showroom’s assessment.

What should I check before buying?+

Ask for the ownership and service history, RC, insurance status, any loan clearance and available inspection information. Inspect the car and take a test drive. Confirm pricing, fees, transfer responsibilities and any warranty terms in writing.

YOUR PRIVACY

A simple privacy note.

This website does not collect enquiry forms on a server. Your saved category preferences stay in your browser and can be cleared by tapping their heart buttons.

Continuing an enquiry opens WhatsApp with the details you entered. You choose whether to send them. WhatsApp and Google Maps apply their own privacy policies. Google Fonts may receive your browser’s standard network information.

Please avoid sending identity documents or financial information through this form. Contact the showroom directly for any document requirements.
